name: signal-dispatch
description: Deterministic enforcement of the 'hey' signal dispatch prefix. Reads table-matched patterns from patterns.txt (single source of truth). Fail-open: enforces only when the KGM extension is confirmed enabled in goose config.yaml; otherwise it never blocks and Rule 1 is left to the model. When enforcing, blocks the first non-dispatch tool call once with a JIT reminder to call search_nodes first. KGM tool name comes from scripts/agentfs-contract.sh; a wrong-prefix search_nodes gets one mismatch notice.
